strengths: Correctly identifies the dominant B-cell program via CD79A/CD79B, MS4A1, CD22, PAX5, IGKC and BANK1
Rank-2 candidate list includes mature/memory/naive B-cell states, allowing hierarchical refinement
weaknesses: Evidence list mixes T-cell genes (TRAC, TRBC1/2, CD3D/CD3G, LCK) with B-cell markers without explicitly separating contamination
Top-k phrasing combines multiple B-cell states and does not commit to a single refined identity

strengths: Top1 B cell is supported by canonical markers CD79A, MS4A1, TNFRSF13C, PAX5, BANK1 and FCRL1
Rank-2 mature B cell (CL:0000785) is a valid hierarchical refinement supported by CD27 and TNFRSF13C
weaknesses: Primary label remains the broader B cell despite the evidence supporting mature B cell as a more specific identity
Included T-cell genes in the marker list without clearly flagging them as contamination

strengths: Marker-based reasoning explicitly invokes canonical B-cell markers MS4A1, CD79A, CD79B, CD22, PAX5 and BANK1
Notes mature B-cell identity supported by CD27 and TNFRSF13C and absence of plasma-cell markers
weaknesses: Final label stops at B cell (CL:0000236) rather than proposing mature B cell (CL:0000785)
Enrichment terms are partly generic immune-system terms and include T-cell activation terms

supporting: Canonical B-cell markers: IGKC, CD79A, CD79B, MS4A1, CD22, PAX5, BANK1, POU2AF1, TNFRSF13C, FCRL1, BLK, STAP1, BCL11A, BACH2, EBF1 (PMID 38678059).
Hierarchical ADDED component 'mature' is directly supported by CD27, TNFRSF13C (BAFF-R), CD22 and FCMR, together with absence of plasma-cell markers (XBP1, PRDM1, SDC1).
conflicting: T-cell genes TRAC, TRBC1/TRBC2, CD3D, CD3G, LCK, CD2 and CCL5 appear in the top marker list
T-cell receptor/activation enrichment terms are outweighed by the dominant B-cell program and interpreted as ambient/doublet contamination.
enrichment_or_literature: B cell receptor signaling pathway, B cell activation, B cell differentiation, IgM immunoglobulin complex, CD22 mediated BCR regulation, and Signaling by the B Cell Receptor (BCR) support B-cell identity (PMID 38678059).
